baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'when the call is made ... on the day of gathering ... move toward remembrance ... leave exchange.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A public sound converts dispersed believers and their bilateral exchanges into a deliberating body. Purposeful movement is the transfer mechanism: people move out of competing transactions so attention can be recollected in common.

activation_trace.role: The raised audible call supplies the public signal that initiates the transfer.
The same root's council or assembly sense lets the call contain its social destination as well as its sound.
Gathering supplies the joining of dispersed parts into a single operative whole.
Purposeful motion supplies direction toward the shared object without requiring a claim about running speed.
Priced exchange supplies the competing dyadic activity that must release its participants.

changed_reading.before: Individuals hear an announcement and hurry to a ritual while pausing business.
changed_reading.after: The summons reconstitutes dispersed exchangers as one remembering public; the imperative primarily marks directed social transfer, not speed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked imperatives 'move' and 'leave' are closed by 'if you know.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing is made operational. The claimed recognition of what is better must produce two observable reallocations at once: intentional work toward remembrance and release of the current transaction.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate work and earning make the movement an enacted commitment rather than a private opinion.
Actual relinquishment supplies the negative action by which the claimed priority becomes visible.
Choosing or seeking the better supplies a discernment that must select between live alternatives.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic claim whose practical truth the imperatives test.

changed_reading.before: The closing condition merely says informed people agree that prayer is better.
changed_reading.after: The condition is diagnostic: knowledge counts here when it reorganizes motion, labor, and relinquishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A call occurs within a named day, gathers people, and commands a leaving of sale.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can be heard as a recurrent return-point inside livelihood rather than a permanent exit from it. A branch of the call-root depicts movement from water to nearby pasture and back; the limited day and gathering event bound the interruption.

activation_trace.role: The watering-to-pasture-and-return cycle supplies a remote but explicit recurrent-motion template for the summons.
A delimited day supplies the temporal container for the interruption.
A day or call that gathers people supplies the recurring convergence point.
Leaving supplies a real release from the present activity without by itself asserting permanent abolition.

changed_reading.before: Sacred time simply defeats commercial time.
changed_reading.after: The verse may install a recurrent gathering pulse within livelihood: a decisive but temporally bounded return to a common source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first pictures all realms already moving in praise. That motion activates the focus imperative as conscious synchronization: human commercial circulation is not rejected as alien matter but periodically redirected into the wider Godward circulation.

activation_trace.role: Running or swimming supplies a continuous field of motion within which the focus movement can be aligned.
Room for going about and earning keeps livelihood inside that moving field rather than outside it.
Directed movement anchors the cosmic analogy in the explicit focus imperative.

structural_cues: 62:1 places everything in the heavens and earth in relation to God before 62:9 addresses one human collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise, swimming or running, and room for livelihood; I supply the arrow from that motion to liturgical synchronization. A live alternative is that the shared roots provide only thematic framing, not a motion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The call removes believers from an otherwise secular stream of activity.
changed_reading.after: The call retunes one stream of human motion so it knowingly participates in a praise already traversing the whole world.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's sequence awakens, recites, purifies, teaches, and inscribes obligation. The Friday summons becomes a recurrent bodily lesson in which heard signs cross into coordinated motion and the interruption of earning.

activation_trace.role: Rousing what is stationary supplies the transition from settled routine to responsive movement.
Following in sequence supplies an ordered transmission that bodies can continue rather than merely hear.
Purification and repair supply the transformation sought by the repeated lesson.
Teaching supplies disclosure that should become the knowledge tested at the focus verse's close.
Inscription that establishes an obligation supplies durable form to the transmitted teaching.
Intentional work anchors the lesson's proposed passage from instruction into practice.

structural_cues: 62:2 orders recitation, purification, teaching of the book, and wisdom before recalling prior evident wandering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awakening, ordered following, purification, teaching, and binding inscription; I infer that 62:9 stages their embodied rehearsal. The live alternative is that 62:2 describes the mission generally while 62:9 regulates one institution only.

changed_reading.before: Friday prayer is one item taught by the messenger.
changed_reading.after: The summons is itself a recurring pedagogy: instruction becomes visible when bodies reorder work and gather around remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those deferred in time who have not yet caught up activate a relay structure inside the focus gathering. The prayer branch of following the leading runner makes each assembly a pace-line by which later or absent members can join an already moving community.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies members who are real to the collective but not yet present.
A follower reaching what is ahead supplies the catch-up motion across the temporal gap.
The runner immediately following the leader supplies a surprising internal image of coordinated succession.
Joining dispersed members anchors the relay image in the named gathering.

structural_cues: 62:3 explicitly adds others who have not yet joined the first recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies later others, catching up, and a prayer-root branch of following a leader; I infer a trans-temporal relay enacted by repeated gathering. The alternative is a narrower reference to contemporaries who join later, without making the ritual itself the relay.

changed_reading.before: The summons organizes only the congregation currently within hearing range.
changed_reading.after: Each gathering may renew a moving communal line into which deferred and distant members can catch up.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated surplus and divine giving alter the economic contrast. Leaving sale does not mean leaving every good; it suspends priced reciprocity in order to acknowledge a prior, unpriced excess from which 'better' can be measured.

activation_trace.role: Surplus or remainder supplies value that exceeds the closed equivalence of a sale.
Benefaction supplies a mode of transfer not generated by reciprocal pricing.
Bestowal supplies the directional source of that noncommercial value.
Exchange for a price supplies the bounded value system being interrupted.
Useful good anchors the surplus model in the verse's explicit comparative judgment.

structural_cues: 62:4 names divine bounty twice around the act of giving it to whomever God wills.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surplus, benefaction, bestowal, priced exchange, and useful good; I infer two rival measures of value. The alternative is simply that divine favor and commercial gain are unrelated goods placed in different passages.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is better because sacred benefit outweighs a foregone commercial profit.
changed_reading.after: The interruption exposes a deeper economy: priced gain depends on and cannot exhaust an unpriced surplus already given.

context_deltas.mechanism: The image of bearing entrusted books without enacting them sharpens the focus condition. Knowledge is not possession of disclosed writing; it is successful carriage across the gap from text to purposeful movement and relinquishment.

activation_trace.role: An example functioning as warning or sign supplies the diagnostic frame for reading the focus condition.
Bearing an entrusted obligation supplies the failed passage from possession to discharge.
A book that uncovers writing supplies content that can remain inert despite being carried.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the context's possession-versus-enactment test in the focus condition.
Intentional action supplies the positive alternative to inert carriage.

structural_cues: 62:5 repeats bearing across people, animal, and books, then condemns failure to bear the entrusted teaching in the relevant sense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entrusted burden, revealing books, and an admonitory example; I infer that the focus verse's conditional knowledge is tested by enacted response. The alternative is that 62:5 targets a distinct community and should not define the later believers' knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Knowing that remembrance is better motivates compliance.
changed_reading.after: Compliance is evidence of knowing: the call tests whether revelation is merely carried or has acquired hands, feet, and economic consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claimed exclusive alliance is tested against truthful performance and what hands have sent ahead. This activates the allegiance branch of sale: 'leave the bay'' can momentarily suspend identity bargains and claimed loyalties so belief is proved by a concrete forward act.

activation_trace.role: A claim made without certainty supplies the unperformed identity assertion under examination.
Alliance, love, and support supply the claimed relation whose truth needs performance.
Fulfilling promise in action supplies the criterion that distinguishes allegiance from assertion.
Advancing something ahead supplies a temporal record made by prior acts.
What the hands earn supplies the embodied evidence of the claimed relation.
Pledged allegiance supplies the focus word's noncommercial bridge to the surrounding claim of loyalty.
Heart-settling assent anchors the model in the believers directly addressed.

structural_cues: 62:6 states an exclusive claim of proximity, tests it with an imperative, and 62:7 answers by pointing to what hands have already advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertain claim, alliance, fulfilled action, prior deeds, and bay' as allegiance; I infer that leaving bay' also loosens unperformed identity contracts. The live alternative is that the focus occurrence denotes only commercial sale and the allegiance resonance remains rhetorical rather than lexical in context.

changed_reading.before: Those who already possess the identity 'believers' are told to pause trade.
changed_reading.after: The pause performs belief: inherited or asserted allegiance is released into an observable choice toward remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context sets two opposed vectors: fleeing death cannot prevent encounter and return, whereas the focus commands purposeful movement toward remembrance. The weekly response becomes practice in converting reactive flight from an unavoidable summons into chosen approach whose product is accountable action.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life and force supplies the feared boundary from which motion attempts to escape.
Flight supplies the uncontrolled vector directly reversed by purposeful approach.
Two opposed things arriving face to face supplies the unavoidable encounter terminating flight.
Being returned to a source supplies the destination that cannot be evaded.
Intended deed supplies what the return ultimately exposes and evaluates.
Purposeful movement supplies the focus verse's counter-vector.
Recovering what forgetfulness loses supplies the chosen destination of that counter-movement.

structural_cues: 62:8 sequences flight, certain meeting, return, and disclosure of deeds immediately before the summons of 62:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motion, inevitable encounter, return, and accountable acts; I infer that the next verse ritualizes a voluntary counter-flight. The alternative is a looser moral contrast between avoidance and obedience without a rehearsal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Believers move toward a scheduled act when summoned.
changed_reading.after: The scheduled summons rehearses how to face the final one: turn flight into chosen approach, remembrance, and answerable action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once prayer reaches completion, the gathered body unfolds across the land, seeks surplus, and keeps remembering. This confirms that leaving sale is a bounded phase in a productive rhythm: converge, remember, disperse, seek, remember again.

activation_trace.role: The recurring movement between a source and nearby livelihood supplies the baseline pulse now tested by the sequel.
Completion supplies a clear temporal boundary rather than permanent withdrawal.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply the centrifugal phase after gathering.
Active seeking restores purposeful livelihood after the bounded interruption.
Surplus supplies what economic seeking pursues while keeping gain framed as excess rather than self-grounding possession.
Continued recollection carries the gathered center into dispersed activity.
Enduring success supplies the stated yield of the complete gather-and-disperse cycle.

structural_cues: 62:10 begins 'when the prayer is completed,' reverses gathering into dispersion, and repeats remembrance inside renewed seeking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion, spreading, seeking, surplus, and remembrance after prayer; I infer a designed social pulse rather than a one-way sacred exit. The narrower alternative is simple permission to resume work after worship.

changed_reading.before: Leaving sale expresses a stable hierarchy in which commerce is simply lower and displaced.
changed_reading.after: The command is one phase of a rhythm that repeatedly recenters livelihood and then sends remembered people back into it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene reverses the focus syntax. In 62:9 people must leave exchange and gather toward remembrance; in 62:11 they fracture the gathering and leave the standing address for trade or distraction. The issue is therefore not whether one leaves, but which relation is abandoned and which source of provision remains standing.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parts supplies the collective form the focus command is meant to produce.
Leaving supplies the first half of the passage's reversed choice of objects.
Priced exchange supplies what should be left before it can pull the gathering apart.
Trade seeking profit supplies the attraction that wins the later competition for attention.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the attentional mechanism behind departure.
The dispersal of a gathering supplies the exact social undoing of Friday's centripetal command.
Abandoning something supplies the mirrored action now aimed at the standing address rather than the sale.
Useful good repeats the focus comparison and forces the rival attractions onto one scale.
Allotted provision supplies the alternative source that relativizes anxious pursuit of the visible transaction.

structural_cues: 62:11 repeats trade, 'better,' and leaving but reverses the destination of movement: the crowd departs and the addressee is left standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored verbs, trade, distraction, fragmentation, comparative good, and provision; I infer a deliberate reversal that explains why 62:9 must preempt sale. The alternative is a simple example of disobedience without a larger contest over what remains socially intact.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks worshippers to prioritize prayer over a transaction.
changed_reading.after: The verse protects the gathered relation itself: leave the transaction now, or its attractions will make the community leave remembrance and break apart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading prayer through the second horse following the leader is form-distant and should never replace the ordinary ritual sense. It remains anchored in the packet's prayer branch, the explicit imperative of striving, and 62:3's latecomers catching up; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy for coordinated succession.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of prayer and striving inside a day that gathers people.

activation_trace.role: The runner following immediately behind the leader supplies the pace-line image within the prayer root.
Competitive striving supplies the possibility of pace and pursuit rather than mere relocation.
The late follower reaching those ahead supplies the context's explicit catch-up vector.

changed_reading.before: Each hearer independently reaches a fixed ritual appointment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the assembly is a moving pace-line: one follows, another catches up, and coordinated pursuit preserves communal continuity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The water-pasture reading is a remote branch activation, not a proposed translation of the call. It remains valid as a material analogy because the focus call branch explicitly cycles herd movement and 62:10 explicitly spreads agents back into land and seeking; render it as an ecological scheduling model, not hidden etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The timed call gathers livelihood-seekers, interrupts sale, and is followed by renewed dispersal.

activation_trace.role: Movement from watering place to nearby pasture and back supplies the recurrent resource-point analogy.
A day or call that gathers supplies the scheduled convergence at that figurative resource point.
Livestock spreading out to pasture supplies a context-side ecological echo of post-gathering dispersal.
Soft productive earth supplies the field into which the gathered body is released.
Seeking supplies the purposeful foraging analogue after replenishment.

changed_reading.before: The call is a stop signal imposed on productive circulation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, the call is a communal watering point that replenishes and redirects the very circulation it interrupts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Treating remembrance as a deed of right beside sale is legally and lexically surprising, and it must not collapse the ordinary sense of remembering God. It remains anchored because the focus places the right-document branch of remembrance directly against sale and allegiance; downstream prose should mark it as a contractual overlay only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'Toward God's remembrance, and leave sale' places remembrance and exchange in direct syntactic competition.

activation_trace.role: A written acknowledgment or deed of right supplies the counter-document image.
Priced exchange supplies the transaction whose immediate claim is suspended.
Pledged allegiance widens the suspended claim from merchandise to binding loyalty.
A detached piece supplies the material severing of the transaction's present hold.
Allotted provision supplies the superior claim under which the commercial claim is relativized.

changed_reading.before: Remembrance is inward attention that temporarily outranks a contract.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, remembrance also functions as a counter-title: a prior divine claim discloses the limits of both commercial contract and performed allegiance.

strongest_changes: The focus movement became a social reassembly rather than an instruction about individual speed.
The book-bearing example turned 'if you know' into a test of whether disclosed knowledge acquires bodily and economic action.
Flight, encounter, and return made the scheduled summons a rehearsal for approaching rather than evading accountability.
The sequel established a gather-disperse rhythm, while the final trade scene reversed 'leaving' and exposed fragmentation of the community as the practical danger.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changed the object and direction of motion: cosmic circulation, awakening, latecomer catch-up, flight, gathering, dispersion, and abandonment all converged on the focus imperatives. This preserved several coexisting readings: civic, pedagogical, eschatological, economic, and the more remote relay, ecological, and contractual overlays.
remaining_uncertainties: The runner and watering-cycle branches are productive material analogies but too distant to govern lexical rendering.
The allegiance branch of sale may expose a genuine identity mechanism, or it may remain only a secondary resonance beside ordinary commerce.
The gather-disperse pulse is strongly supported by 62:10, but whether it describes all livelihood or specifically the immediate Friday interval remains open.
The counter-document branch of remembrance should remain contained unless another independent textual feature strengthens its legal force.
